name: Reading Progress
description: A thin reading progress bar at the top of long pages, plus an optional back-to-top button. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation with a tiny JavaScript fallback.

panels.title: Reading progress
panels.description: The progress bar at the top of long pages and the back-to-top button. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show a reading progress bar
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: color
fields.title: Colour
fields.description: The bar and the button. Leave empty for rose (#f43f5e).

fields.name: back-to-top
fields.title: Show a back-to-top button
fields.description: A round button in the corner that appears once the reader has scrolled half a screen down.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get the bar or the button. For example: home, contact
